environments.selectProjectFirst: Select an endpoint from a project first, then define variables such as username here.

projectSettings.title: Workspace settings
projectSettings.environmentsHint: Define variables such as base_url or username. They replace {{placeholders}} in URLs, headers, and body — e.g. base_url: http://localhost:8080/api/v1 for local testing.
projectSettings.noEnvironments: No environment for this workspace yet.

workspaceImport.title: Import workspace
workspaceImport.chooseHint: Import an API specification as a workspace. Supported file formats:
workspaceImport.fromUrlHint: Fetch an OpenAPI spec over the network
workspaceImport.urlHint: Enter the URL of an OpenAPI 3.x document (JSON or YAML).
workspaceImport.invalidUrl: Invalid URL. Please enter an http or https address.
workspaceImport.formatsHint: Serverless and Postman Collection (*.json) are file-only. URL import is OpenAPI 3.x only. Swagger 2.0 is not supported.

wizard.loadedHint: Next, set up the default environment — define variables such as base_url there.
wizard.baseUrlPlaceholderHint: Endpoint URLs use {{base_url}} as a placeholder. You can adjust the value in the next step.
wizard.environmentHint: Variables and API tokens apply to this environment only — e.g. different tokens for Default and PROD.
wizard.authDetectedHint: The API spec defines Bearer authentication. The token is stored for this environment and sent with requests.
wizard.environmentOptional: Without variables or a token, no environment is created — you can add one later in project settings.
